exchanges: ok first night in res and the walls are SO thin
That is a classic residence experience. Can you hear much from next door?
everything lol. someone is blasting music down the hall
Earplugs might be worth picking up this week.
good call. my roommate amara seems nice tho, kinda quiet
A quiet roommate is a good start.
yeah she said shes already homesick and its day one
That is really common in the first week. Is home far for her?
super far. shes taking the bus back to Winnipeg for reading week, like a 20 hour ride
That is a long ride, though she will have plenty of time to read.
better her than me. ok registration finally went thru, im officially in biochemistry
Congratulations, that is a big step.
thanks!! orgo is gonna kill me tho
Lots of people find organic chemistry tough, but study groups help a lot.
the dining hall says they cant promise anything is free of peanuts so i ate a banana for dinner. hate carrying my epipen everywhere
That sounds stressful. Is there anyone there you can ask about safe options?
the lady at the counter said theres a seperate allergy station, i just didnt see it
Good, that should make meals a lot easier.
my rA juniper did the floor meeting tonight, shes from Saskatoon so she kept making jokes about the cold here
Sounds like she keeps things light.
lol ya. the wind off the harbour is no joke
It really is, especially near the water.
my mom ifeoma keeps texting me every hour asking if i ate
She is probably missing you. A quick daily call might calm her down.
my brother chidi said hes coming down to visit when he gets time off from Costco
That would be nice, a familiar face in the first month.
he works like every weekend tho so who knows
Hopefully he can swap a shift.
signed up for spin class at the gym, its tuesdays at 7am which is insane
Early classes are hard, but you will feel great after.
also my cousin amara, not my roommate, the other amara lol, says shes going to Barcelona over winter break with her friends
Two Amaras to keep straight now. That should be a fun trip for her.
so jealous
Maybe you can plan a trip of your own next summer.
wait no i misread the schedule, spin is thursdays not tuesdays
Good catch, at least you did not show up on the wrong day.
i 100% would have shown up at 7am to an empty room
That would have been a rough morning.
met my lab partner today, dmitri, hes super chill
Good to have someone easy to work with in the lab.
he already read the whole lab manual so were ahead
That should make the first labs smoother.
he also told me he plays cello in the uni orchestra, im in awe
That takes a lot of practice to keep up alongside a science degree.
wait where is my roommate going for reading week again
ok shes back from the shower, gonna try to sleep
Good night, and good luck with the noise down the hall.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your roommate Amara is heading home to Winnipeg.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your roommate Amara is heading to Barcelona.

which morning is my cycling thing at the gym
